description: storm_bear default look, LIGHT proxy finish: the colour is the Pixal3D proxy's own texture (white + charcoal fur lifted to the sheet's tones, crystals to the sheet's crystal blue) baked onto the low (improved/textures/storm_bear_basecolor.png); proxy_albedo (white) tints it; three GLOW regions carry the emission (Glow -> Emission Color): the eyes, the crystal lightning cores, the crystal bodies (hand + toe claws included)

proxy_albedo.note: tint over the baked proxy albedo (light mode); white keeps the fur / crystals as baked. Sheet chips for reference: fur 230,221,218, crystal 188,218,253 / 61,106,244, charcoal 101,108,136 / 69,71,86, lightning cyan 46,193,253

eye_glow.note: the glowing blue eyes (sheet front / side eye pixels, brightest quarter 119..144,163..188,231..240); rgb white keeps the baked albedo

crystal_core.note: the lightning inside the crystals (the sheet's 6th chip, bright cyan 46,193,253): the brightest crystal faces

crystal_glow.note: the crystals' inner glow (sheet chip 61,106,244), low so the faceted albedo still reads; no external arcs (sheet)
